transcript: Facilitator: Let's start with top constraints.
Bayo: Data access from merchants is the bottleneck for ML modules.
Ngozi: For education, data costs for students—zero-rating helped us.
Ahmed: Drivers resist monitoring; incentives changed the narrative.
Seyi: Aggregator commissions squeeze margins; we push direct channels.
Uche: Clients demand cybersecurity controls before granting site access.
Funmi: Fees and reconciliation are issues, but visibility pays for itself.
consensus_themes: Privacy-preserving data sharing unlocks analytics adoption
Aligning incentives reframes surveillance as performance
disagreements: Extent to which fees deter micro-merchants

transcript: Facilitator: What binds most?
Aisha: Power and finance. Vendor lease made it feasible.
Tunde: Vendor lock-in on sensors; we pushed for data export.
Ruth: Heat waves raise costs; timers mitigate, but batteries still pricey.
Halima: Trust in mobile money grows with demonstrations.
Hassan: Extension services are thin—peer learning fills gaps.
consensus_themes: Hybrid energy plus process control improves quality
Peer demonstrations build trust for digital finance
disagreements: Whether subsidies or leases are better for diffusion
policy_suggestions: Battery import duty relief for productive use
Open standards for ag IoT data
Revive extension services with digital toolkits

transcript: Facilitator: Online-offline mix—what works?
Chinedu: Broadcast lists and spec sheets reduced returns.
Emeka: Payment links killed fake alerts.
Zainab: Solar freezer stabilized cold chain; delivery windows expanded.
Aminat: Short videos convert, but trust issues remain—pay-on-delivery in-town.
Chioma: Logistics pricing swings; pooled pickups help.
consensus_themes: Trust-building tactics are core to social commerce
disagreements: Effectiveness of pay-on-delivery beyond city centers

transcript: Facilitator: Adoption blockers?
Musa: Skills—handover from design to CNC still leaks quality.
Titi: Change management in stores required incentives.
Ahmed: OTP and safety bonuses raised on-time delivery.
Ifeoma: Policy risk on components; we hedge with multiple suppliers.
Samuel: Broadband dead zones break tracking.
Isah: UPS bridges micro-outages but not long ones.
consensus_themes: Pairing vendor engineers with trainees accelerates capability
disagreements: Whether to centralize or decentralize inventory control
policy_suggestions: Skills vouchers for SME tech upskilling
